description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the class ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory, verifying its behavior, input validation, and functionality related to parsing JSON field selectors.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactoryTest
classes.description: A final class dedicated to unit testing the ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory class, ensuring correct parsing, immutability, and input validation behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorFactory instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullString
methods.description: Expects NullPointerException when creating a new instance with null string input.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullOptions
methods.description: Expects NullPointerException when creating a new instance with null options.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithEmptyString
methods.description: Expects JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException when creating a new instance with an empty string.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithStringContainingUnevenCountOfOpeningAndClosingParentheses
methods.description: Expects JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException when the input string has mismatched parentheses.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that a valid JSON field selector string produces a JsonFieldSelector with the expected number of elements.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromSimpleKeyString
methods.description: Tests creation of JsonFieldSelector from a simple key string, expecting a size of 1.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromStringWithSubFields
methods.description: Tests parsing of a complex string with subfields, verifying correct pointers are generated.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromStringWithNestedSubFields
methods.description: Tests parsing of nested subfields, verifying full set of pointers.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidEncodedSubFields
methods.description: Checks that invalid URL-encoded subfields throw JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidParenthesis
methods.description: Validates that malformed parenthesis throw JsonFieldSelectorInvalidException.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidParenthesisEncoded
methods.description: Validates error handling for encoded malformed parenthesis.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidEmptyParenthesis
methods.description: Checks handling of empty parentheses input.

methods.name: newJsonFieldSelectorFromInvalidParenthesisOrder
methods.description: Checks handling of misordered parentheses input.
